notes.title: Green Heights will release in exactly 7 days!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Green Heights will release in exactly 7 days! 

I want to thank you all for being with me during the pre-release phase. You might not realize it, but you've all helped me immensely in reaching this milestone. Without your encouragement, feedback, and participation in the demo, I wouldn’t have been able to create such a fantastic game. 

I have one last request, if you purchase the game, I would deeply appreciate a review on Steam. The goal is to reach 10 reviews as quickly as possible. At that point, Steam gives the game a significant spike in visibility. By doing this, you'll be helping a ton, and I will be incredibly grateful! 

Beyond that, I’m super excited to see you all on the leaderboard! For now, I’m holding back on my best time. I’m looking forward to finding a strong opponent to race against!

See you all in 7 days!

notes.title: Green Heights will release on May 5th at 2:00 PM EDT
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Big news! Green Heights will release on May 5th at 2:00 PM EDT.

For those interested, I will be on the Green Heights Discord, sharing my screen while playing the game.

notes.title: Small Update following player feedback
notes.notes:
- Fixed ladder bug where sometimes you could not climb up until you backed down.

- Smoother FOV transition between Sprint and Crouch.

- Added more friction to player movement. Your movement will be a bit sharper.

- Increased the radius of the player gravity map. This will make you less slippery in the air.

- Fixed a bug where the wind SFX wouldn't stop when resetting a run.

Enjoy!

Feel free to communicate any bugs or feedback.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The Steam Next Fest patch has just been uploaded. Here are the bullet points of the update:

- 200m total to climb

- Ghost of your personal best time

- Leaderboard reset

- Game stats

- Invert X-Y axis option

- V-Sync option

- Graphic settings option

- Frame rate limit option

- Screen resolution option

- Ladder debug

- Visual upgrades

- New sound effects

Enjoy! Let me know if you find any bugs or issues.

notes.title: New Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey Hey everyone!

Since the leaderboard update, I have been working on new features, smoother gameplay experience, and level design improvements.

Green Heights now supports key bindings! Upon opening the control tab, you will be able to assign any input you want to different actions.

For those who like to have more control over their landing, you will now be able to sneak using the CTRL input. This will not only slow you down, but it will also keep you safe from falling off edges.

Climbing a ladder is now much smoother and faster than before!

I have been learning and working on level design. Modules that were confusing or boring have been updated.

The next major update will take place just before the February Next Fest, probably around mid-February. At this time, the leaderboard will reset since the level will be longer.

See you all in the terrarium, and happy holidays!
